title: Agnostics: Learning to Code in Any Programming Language via Reinforcement with a Universal Learning Environment
abstract: arXiv:2508.04865v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) already excel at writing code in high-resource languages such as Python and JavaScript, yet stumble on low-resource languages that remain essential to science and engineering. Besides the obvious shortage of pre-training data, post-training itself is a bottleneck: every new language seems to require new datasets, test harnesses, and reinforcement-learning (RL) infrastructure.   We introduce Agnostics, a language-agnostic post-training pipeline that eliminates this per-language engineering. translated_title: Agnostics：通过强化学习与通用学习环境学习任意编程语言的代码编写
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）已经擅长编写Python和JavaScript等高资源语言的代码，但在对科学和工程仍然至关重要的低资源语言上却表现不佳。除了预训练数据的明显短缺之外，后训练本身也是一个瓶颈：每一种新语言似乎都需要新的数据集、测试框架和强化学习（RL）基础设施。我们提出了Agnostics，一个语言无关的后训练流水线，消除了这种针对每种语言的工程工作。其关键思想是仅通过代码的外部可观察行为来评判代码，因此单个验证器就可以测试用任何语言编写的解决方案。具体而言，我们（i）使用LLM将现有的单元测试数据集重写为输入/输出（I/O）格式，（ii）提供简短的配置来告诉验证器如何编译和运行目标语言，（iii）在健壮的代码执行环境中应用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）……
tldr: 提出了语言无关的后训练流水线Agnostics，通过仅依据代码外部可观察行为进行评判的通用验证器，配合I/O格式的测试数据转换与RLVR强化学习，使LLM无需为每种语言单独构建数据集和测试基础设施即可学会任意编程语言。
en_tdlr: Agnostics is a language-agnostic post-training pipeline that enables LLMs to learn any programming language via RLVR, using a universal verifier that judges code solely by externally observable behavior, thereby eliminating per-language engineering of datasets and test harnesses.
